يزدرعون (form VIII)
# يَزْدَرِعُونَ (yazdariʕūna) /jaz.da.ri.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# يُزْدَرَعُونَ (yuzdaraʕūna) /juz.da.ra.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
